_note: Pinned against kasm-session-runtime's v0.2.0-rc.13 tag (pre-release). This tag ships runner.escalation_pause_s (wine-assess's escalation-pause request): an operator bound on the C2 escalation pause, in KASM_RUNTIME_CONFIG_FILE or as KASM_RUNTIME_RUNNER_ESCALATION_PAUSE_S. Absent keeps today's behaviour (the pause runs to the wait budget); 0 records the escalation and finishes; N sleeps min(N, time until WaitBudget). For unattended runs, where nobody is coming to take the session, so an escalate no longer holds a session slot for the whole remaining deadline. Verdict/outcome, Escalation.PausedS and the Before/After snapshots are unchanged. The sidebar (pkgs/kasm-ai-runtime-sidebar) is pinned to the same commit -- bump both together. Hashes computed by downloading both published objects (curl) and taking sha256-<base64 of the raw SHA-256 digest>, the same value nix's fixed-output check computes for a fetchurl. Re-pin the same way: download kasm-session-runtime-linux-<amd64|arm64>.<tag>.<short> and kasm-ai-runtime-sidebar.tar.gz.<tag>.<short>, hash, update.
